findings.text: _resolves_inside_repository duplicates the worktree/repository containment mapping in _repository_scope_paths (same file, line 534 — duplication, not extension), so a second copy of the rule can drift from the one promotion resolves declarations with.

The docstring claims the write-time audit and promotion 'refuse the same set of paths', but promotion's caller at reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py:2983 uses _changed_artifacts_needing_acceptance, which stops at the exclusive class and never applies the outside-repository kind added here, so the two surfaces still differ for that class.

The outside-repository arm calls _declaration_needed_paths directly rather than through _orientation_substance, so the test proves the helper's classification and not that the audit refuses such a path; a regression dropping that class from the audit would leave the test green.
